rules.ladder: A call ladder (contract level): calls built on still-open expiries — in one session or over a few settles, among the very biggest builds of all names that day, or among the big builders day after day — mostly near the money, calls well ahead of the puts, spread across several expiries rather than piled into one or two contracts, and no sign of call selling. Any price state — no washout needed.
rules.state: Washed out = the washout board's washout · At highs = close to the 52-week high · Pullback = a moderate dip under the high with a flat-to-falling 20 days · Basing = well under the high with a flat 20 days · Other = the rest.
rules.tiers: L = call ladder on (any price state) · B = building: a big or persistent build that passes the ladder and call-selling gates but misses a shape gate · J = rejected big builds (spreads, one expiry, call selling…).
rules.score: Order: L by persistence, then build size; B by build size; J by dollar size.
